description: Found a bug, or have an idea to make MU better? File it here. Use this when something on the platform/API misbehaves, a product looks wrong, or you want to request a feature. It lands in the MA-council triage queue. Requires `Authorization: Bearer <api_key>`.

category.description: bug = something is broken; feature = new capability; improvement = make existing better.

description.description: What happened / what you want. Steps to reproduce for bugs. (<=2000 chars)

sku.description: Optional: the SKU this feedback is about.

name: mu_submit_feedback
title: Report a bug or suggest an improvement to MU
